stem: How did the U.S. Supreme Court decision in Dred Scott v. Sandford affect the lives of free and enslaved African Americans?

options.label: A
options.text: As long as they were peaceful, both groups were able to participate in political protests.

options.label: B
options.text: Because they were not considered taxpayers, both groups were unable to attend religious services.

options.label: C
options.text: As long as they were lawful, both groups were able to seek out economic opportunities.

options.label: D
options.text: Because they were not considered citizens, both groups were unable to use the legal system.
